title: Mask layer SWF export: set ClipDepth / HasClipDepth in PlaceObject2
description:
Mask layers render correctly in the authoring stage (Canvas clip regions) but published SWFs ignore the mask entirely. compile.ts line ~755 has an explicit TODO: ClipDepth / HasClipDepth is never set on PlaceObject2 for mask layer objects.

In SWF, a mask is expressed by placing the mask shape with PlaceObject2 ClipDepth set to the depth of the last masked layer. Ruffle interprets this correctly.

Acceptance criteria:
- A document with a mask layer + masked layer produces a SWF where the mask shape's PlaceObject2 record has HasClipDepth=1 and ClipDepth = depth of last masked object + 1.
- Add a test in packages/swf/src/__tests__/integration.test.ts that compiles a document with a mask layer and asserts ClipDepth is set.
- Ruffle renders the masked output correctly (manual visual check or visual-oracle fixture).

Key files: packages/swf/src/compile.ts (PlaceObject2 encoding), packages/swf/src/writer.ts (HasClipDepth flag bit).
